name: ci-ownership-history
goal: CI full checks read immutable ownership review commits without changing credentials or verification scope

evidence: GitHub Full check at 349b5fea5 rejects the guard because shallow checkout omits review commit 16ab6fdf6. Both jobs must read immutable review history without write credentials.
Standard Linux setup coverage checked tools and execution only; macOS alone checked complete source history. Extend the same Linux case with full-history and credential-removal assertions.
